description: Governed entry point for Colorado licensed Child Care Center acquisition and offline normalization.
redirect_policy: Fixed anonymous official Colorado metadata, aggregate and selected SODA endpoints; redirects rejected and retained mode makes no network requests.
retry: No automatic source retries or job restart. Preserve completed acquisitions for explicit offline reuse.
checkpoint: Persist start, verified child releases and terminal receipt; independently replay and atomically advance the governed pointer last.
idempotency: Immutable UUID releases; retained inputs avoid repulling, historical releases are not overwritten, and failed runs preserve the prior pointer.
cancellation: Abort transport and pacing, drain writers, retain completed child evidence, and inspect uncertain ownership.
retention_profile: Internal center-only source candidates and immutable receipts. ZIP5 and ZIP4 remain separate; missing geography remains explicit; no business polygons or public record export.
